limitations: Study dates are Jan 6–8, 2025 PST, not the entire incident lifetime. Jan 8 is a later checkpoint during the incident, not post-fire.
One contextual monitor south of the fire: 06-037-1103, POC 3, parameter 88101, method 170. It does not measure exposure within the perimeter.
71 supplied hourly rows of 72 expected slots; absent records remain missing. IT/IJ qualifier codes are retained without assuming causation or regulatory validity.
Firep25_1 was released in April 2026; static historical perimeter, never an hourly fire-growth footprint.
2025 LRA recommendations postdate ignition; local adoption/effective dates are not established here. SRA effective April 1, 2024.
FHSZ is long-term hazard, not immediate risk, smoke, damage or evacuation guidance. Unmapped is not Low.
Geometry: service projection to WGS84, Shapely 2.1.2 make_valid for invalid topology, hazard polygons clipped to study bbox; no simplification. Raw download checksums retained.
Terrain is basemap relief only. Hazard, terrain and monitor co-location do not establish causation.
